2610.06782.title: T-Search: An Open Agentic Retriever and Playground for Hard Multi-Step Search
2610.06782.paper_summary: We present T-Search, an open-weight agentic retriever for hard multi-step search. Given a question and a search tool over a fixed corpus, it runs a bounded multi-round search and returns a ranked list of evidence chunks with short justifications, leaving answer generation to a downstream model, so backend and generator can be swapped without retraining. T-Search is built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and trained on adversarially filtered synthetic search tasks with round-sliced supervised fine-tuning followed by GSPO on a recall reward. Averaged over seven English and Russian benchmarks with gold evidence annotations, it reaches 56.0 Recall@10 with one rollout, 14.4 points above its base, and 61.3 with three fused rollouts, outperforming larger open models. We release the model, harness, live demo, and three benchmarks, including TRuST, the first native-Russian hard-search benchmark.
2610.06782.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 T-Search，一個用於困難多步搜尋的開放權重代理檢索器。<lb/>給定一個問題和一個固定語料庫上的搜尋工具，它執行有界的多輪搜尋並返回一個帶有簡短理由的證據片段排名列表，將答案生成留給下游模型，因此後端和生成器可以在不重新訓練的情況下進行替換。<lb/>T-Search 建立在 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 之上，並在經過對抗性過濾的合成搜尋任務上進行訓練，採用圓形切片的監督微調，隨後在回憶獎勵上進行 GSPO。<lb/>在七個帶有金證據註釋的英語和俄語基準上平均計算，它在一次展開中達到 56.0 Recall@10，比其基準高出 14.4 分，而在三次融合展開中達到 61.3，超越了更大的開放模型。<lb/>我們發布了模型、工具、實時演示和三個基準，包括 TRuST，第一個本土俄語的困難搜尋基準。
